title: docsrs-cli commands success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command `commands`. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms.

agent_notes.description: Stable hints for LLM callers about streams and lifecycle. All four keys are compile-time constants, so none of them is ever absent.

stdout.description: What stdout carries: data only, as a JSON envelope or as markdown

stderr.description: What stderr carries: diagnostics only, never contract data

json_auto.description: When JSON is chosen without being asked for: stdout that is not a TTY selects JSON unless --format markdown|text overrides it. This is why a piped call answers in JSON with no flag.

lifecycle.description: Process model: BORN, EXECUTE, FINALIZE, DIE. One-shot with no daemon, so no state survives the call and nothing has to be torn down between calls.
